card.name: Just before fold or times multipliers
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before a number that states how many times larger something is, such as 1000-fold, 50-125 times or 10-fold. It also appears in dilution ratios and multiply-by phrases.

modes.label: Fold-change before a number
modes.description: The gap before a number followed by -fold, describing how much a dose or exposure was exceeded.

modes.label: Times the recommended dose
modes.description: The gap before a range of numbers followed by times, comparing a dose to a reference dose.

modes.description: Words or symbols leading into a multiplier or dilution ratio.
